note: RV park behind a Route-66-style motel where US-50 crosses the Gunnison River in Delta; 1,285 ft of river frontage. The park advertises short-term and seasonal stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 30 RV + 4 tent sites, full hookups 20/30/50 amp, laundry and showers; 17 back-ins + 9 pull-throughs. Booking changed to phone: the online engine sells only motel rooms and tent sites ($25), no RV sites. No posted RV rate (RV Life $$ is the only price). Cleared the note-derived camp store and dump (the operator lists neither); season left as stored (the operator does not say). Imagery: the southern rows of rigs sit roughly 10-30 m from the Gunnison behind a brushy bank, consistent with the stored riverfront. Note trimmed.
flags: Long-stay character check (AWH five tests): the home page says 'short term and seasonal lodging', RV sites are not sold online (only the motel and tent sites), and recent Google reviews (3.2 stars, 105) describe month-long stays, long-term renters and residents' utility billing and eviction complaints. Nightly RV stays are not shown to be sold; candidate for the long-stay review.
Price: no RV rate posted by the operator or the booking engine; the only price indicator is the stored RV Life $$ tier.
Note claim removed: 'nightly bookable online' is contradicted for RV sites by the operator's engine (motel and tent only).
